cards.card_text: Then God gives Moses a formula for incense: gum resin, onycha, galbanum and pure frankincense in equal measures, blended by a perfumer and seasoned with salt.
cards.verse_text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures, and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
cards.snippet: …also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures, and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of…

cards.verse_text: He is to pour olive oil on it, put frankincense on it,
cards.snippet: He is to pour olive oil on it, put frankincense on it,

cards.card_text: The priest takes a handful of the flour and oil, with all the frankincense, and burns it on the altar as a memorial portion.
cards.verse_text: The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food…

cards.card_text: The firstfruits grain offering gets oil and frankincense too, and the priest burns its memorial portion.
cards.verse_text: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
cards.snippet: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

cards.card_text: A grain offering of fine flour gets olive oil and frankincense (Leviticus 2:1), but this flour gets neither.
cards.verse_text: He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
cards.snippet: He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

cards.card_text: Why does the flour for this sin offering get no olive oil and no frankincense?
cards.verse_text: He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
cards.snippet: He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

cards.card_text: The priest takes a handful of the fine flour and oil, with all the frankincense, and burns it on the altar as the memorial portion.
cards.verse_text: The priest is to remove a handful of fine flour and olive oil, together with all the frankincense from the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …a handful of fine flour and olive oil, together with all the frankincense from the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar…

cards.card_text: Pure frankincense goes near each row as a memorial portion for the bread, a food offering to the LORD.
cards.verse_text: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread, a food offering to the LORD.
cards.snippet: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion…

cards.card_text: No oil poured over it and no frankincense on it, because it's a grain offering for jealousy.
cards.verse_text: He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.
cards.snippet: He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering…

cards.card_text: Others look after the sanctuary's furnishings, plus the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense and spices, and some of the priests' sons mix the spices.
cards.verse_text: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
cards.snippet: …articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.

cards.card_text: Once the rooms are purified, Nehemiah has the articles of God's house put back in them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense.
cards.verse_text: Then I ordered that the rooms be purified, and I had the articles of the house of God restored to them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense.
cards.snippet: …house of God restored to them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense.

cards.card_text: Right now, something is coming up out of the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant.
cards.verse_text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?
cards.snippet: …from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?

cards.card_text: And he says that before the day breaks and the shadows flee, he'll make his way to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.
cards.verse_text: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
cards.snippet: …my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He has burdened Israel with offerings and wearied them with frankincense.
cards.verse_text: I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
cards.snippet: I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

cards.card_text: Gold and frankincense Myrrh and aloes Linen and purple cloth
cards.verse_text: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
cards.snippet: …Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.

cards.card_text: Whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig's blood, and whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.
cards.verse_text: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.
cards.snippet: …a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD asks, “What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land?” Sheba is a land in Arabia, and friend, that is a LONG way to haul anything.
cards.verse_text: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land?
cards.snippet: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land?

cards.card_text: The eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria are carrying grain offerings and frankincense.
cards.verse_text: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their garments, and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, carrying grain offerings and frankincense for the house of the LORD.
cards.snippet: …cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, carrying grain offerings and frankincense for the house of the LORD.

cards.verse_text: Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
cards.snippet: …they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
